measurements.scope: Representative finite hardware routes, same four goals repeated twice per build; contexts captured every measured frame. Initial stationary contexts match exactly. Feedback route timings are not deterministic input movies or causally isolated A/B timings. QPC work before pacing includes probe and host overhead and may submit GPU work asynchronously. No broad dynamic pool/coordinate-limit/streaming acceptance.

offline_hook_checks.scope: Two image bases; eight isolated hook sites replay displaced native operations with integer registers, ESP and flags equal. API/COM/helper success stubs, ABI argument checks, initialization failures, inactive/level/arena bypass, counter borrow, ring wrap, exact known census/context/counters. Does not assert API internals/LastError or complete engine equivalence.

decoder_checks.scope: Frequency bounds, truncated row, publication words/sequence, duration and timestamp ordering.
